name: cicero
description: CICERO — the house voice. The 22 communication rules under one governing readability rule (result first, plain words, avoid a specialized term instead of glossing it, recommend one option, push back with reasons, honesty about verification, stay in scope) ship as a force-for-plugin output style applied at the system-prompt level. A SessionStart hook shows a banner and picks the conversation language; a UserPromptSubmit hook keeps the reply language current.
